topics.title: Coursework conditions
topics.summary: UQ classifies assessment tasks as Secure or Open from Semester 2, 2026. Task instructions still specify permitted materials and tools, including any AI-use and disclosure requirements. An AI-required condition applies when students are assessed on their use of AI.
topics.scope: UQ coursework assessment tasks; the task instructions control the permitted materials and tools.

topics.title: Privacy and data
topics.summary: UQ research guidance cautions against sharing sensitive or confidential research data with public AI tools. Staff Copilot Chat prompts, responses and uploaded files are retained under distinct Microsoft 365 storage and retention arrangements; the source gives no retention period.
topics.scope: The retention statements describe a staff research scenario and should not be generalized to student accounts or all tools.

additionalTopics.title: Academic integrity and formal proceedings
additionalTopics.summary: UQ describes AI outputs used without attribution and contrary to staff directions as plagiarism and academic misconduct. Its formal student misconduct procedure sets hearing, decision, penalty and appeal safeguards; it is a general procedure, not an AI-specific rule.
additionalTopics.scope: The AI-related statement retains both conditions. Procedural clauses apply only to a formal UQ student misconduct proceeding.
